job.title: Assistant Buyer
job.description:
About the role

We're looking for a highly organised, commercially minded Assistant Buyer to take ownership of factory communications, stock planning, reporting and product data.

This is a varied, hands-on role within a small team, offering plenty of responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact across the business.

Key responsibilities 
  • Manage overseas factory communications, purchase orders and production timelines. 
  • Monitor sales performance, stock levels and forward buying requirements. 
  • Prepare Excel reports and analyse sales and inventory data. 
  • Maintain accurate product information across the wholesale website and sales ordering platform. 
  • Coordinate shipping documentation, customs requirements and import permits. 
  • Support customer enquiries, showroom visitors and general team operations.
About you

You'll be analytical, proactive and exceptionally organised, with the confidence to manage multiple priorities and communicate with overseas suppliers.

You will also bring: 
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas and lookups. 
  • Experience in buying, stock planning or inventory management. 
  • Strong written communication and supplier management skills. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving ability. 
  • An interest in using AI tools to improve efficiency and processes. 
  • A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to help wherever needed.
Wholesale, homewares, giftware or importing experience will be highly regarded.

The opportunity 
  • Up to two overseas buying trips each year. 
  • Involvement in major trade shows and product photoshoots. 
  • A varied role with genuine ownership and responsibility. 
  • The opportunity to work closely with the business owner and influence buying decisions.
Apply now!

job.title: FASHION Territory Sales Manager / Wholesale Account Manager - VIC
job.description:
The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity to join a successful, established Australian lifestyle brand specialising in premium fashion, baby, gift and homewares. Built on a strong wholesale foundation, the business is committed to quality, elevated design and sustainability, while maintaining a contemporary, trend-driven approach.

With a loyal and well-established retail customer base, the business is seeking an experienced Territory Sales Manager / Wholesale Account Manager to manage and grow its Victorian territory.

This is an exciting opportunity to represent a highly regarded Australian brand, nurture longstanding retail relationships and identify new opportunities to drive sales and expand the business.

The Role
  • Manage and grow an established portfolio of wholesale accounts.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities.
  • Present seasonal collections and drive forward orders.
  • Maximise sales through replenishment, reorders and account development.
  • Build strong relationships with independent retailers and national buyers.
  • Merchandise and strengthen brand presence in-store.
  • Represent the brand at seasonal launches and trade events.
  • Work closely with head office to achieve sales targets and grow the territory.
The role is predominantly field-based, visiting and presenting to existing and prospective customers.

About You
  • Proven experience in territory sales, wholesale or account management.
  • Strong relationship-building and business development skills.
  • Commercially minded, proactive and results-driven.
  • Confident presenting products and engaging with retail buyers.
  • Experience in fashion, lifestyle, gift or homewares will be highly regarded.
  • Competent CRM and computer skills.
  • Current driver's licence and reliable vehicle.
What's on Offer?
  • Represent a well-established and highly regarded Australian brand.
  • Inherit a loyal customer base with genuine growth potential.
  • Autonomous role with strong head office support.
  • Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid WFH.
  • Generous salary package including base, super, sales commission and vehicle allowance.
  • Tools of trade provided.
Ready to take ownership of a territory and make your mark? Apply now!

job.title: Warehouse Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Warehouse Manager to take ownership of a busy Melbourne distribution centre and lead a team of five to ten warehouse staff.

This is a practical, hands-on leadership role suited to someone who enjoys being actively involved in daily warehouse operations while driving team performance, improving processes and ensuring everything runs efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead, motivate and manage a team of warehouse staff.
  • Be actively involved in day-to-day warehouse operations.
  • Oversee receiving, picking, packing, dispatch and stock control.
  • Manage workflow, rostering and labour requirements.
  • Maintain high standards of order accuracy and inventory management.
  • Coordinate incoming deliveries, freight and outbound dispatch.
  • Monitor warehouse performance, productivity and operating costs.
  • Ensure workplace health and safety standards are maintained.
  • Identify and implement improvements to warehouse processes and efficiencies.
  • Manage warehouse equipment, layout and consumables.
About You
You are a hands-on leader who leads by example, enjoys being on the warehouse floor and takes pride in running an organised and efficient operation.

You will ideally have:
  • At least five years' experience managing a warehouse or distribution centre.
  • Proven experience leading and developing a small warehouse team.
  • Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory and dispatch.
  • Experience with WMS or ERP inventory systems.
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • A good understanding of workplace health and safety.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a busy environment.
Desirable: Current forklift licence (LF) and experience with EDI, RFID or imported stock.

What's on Offer?
  • Hands-on leadership role with genuine ownership.
  • Support from head office.
  • Opportunity to lead and develop an established team.
  • Scope to improve processes and make a real impact.
  • Melbourne-based opportunity.
If you're a hands-on Warehouse Manager who leads from the front, enjoys a busy environment and takes pride in getting the job done right, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Customer Service & Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
Customer Service & Accounts Receivable Officer

Melbourne, VIC | Full-Time | Textiles & Clothing

Our client is seeking a friendly, organised and proactive Customer Service & Accounts Receivable Officer to support their day-to-day operations.
Combining customer service, reception and accounts receivable, this hands-on position offers plenty of variety. You’ll be a welcoming first point of contact, help customers with their enquiries and keep invoicing and payments running smoothly.

About the Role

Customer Service & Administration
  • Respond to phone and email enquiries, providing helpful, professional service.
  • Assist customers with orders, product availability, pricing and delivery updates.
  • Work with internal teams to resolve queries and keep customers informed.
  • Welcome visitors, manage correspondence and provide reception support.
  • Maintain accurate records and assist with general office administration.
  • Build strong customer relationships through reliable service and follow-up.
Accounts Receivable
  • Prepare and issue customer invoices and credit notes.
  • Process payments and accurately allocate receipts.
  • Monitor accounts and follow up overdue payments.
  • Reconcile customer accounts and investigate payment discrepancies.
  • Resolve account enquiries and liaise with the accounts team on outstanding balances.
  • Maintain accurate records and assist with regular reporting.
About You

You’re approachable, reliable and comfortable balancing customer enquiries with tasks that require accuracy and attention to detail. You take ownership of your work and follow things through.

You’ll ideally bring:
  • Experience in customer service, reception, administration or accounts receivable.
  • Strong communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
  • Good numerical skills and close attention to detail.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office and accounting or ERP systems.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive approach to solving problems.
  • The ability to work independently and contribute to a team.
What’s on Offer?
  • A varied full-time role across customer service, administration and accounts.
  • The opportunity to join an established textile business.
  • A friendly, supportive team environment.
  • A hands-on position where your contribution makes a difference.
Interested? Apply now with your resume. We’d love to hear from you.

job.description:

Casual | Minimum 3 days per week

Interested? Send your CV to valerie@permanser.com.au.

job.title: Production Coordinator - Schoolwear
job.description:
Production Coordinator – Schoolwear
Melbourne | Full-time | Garment Production

We are seeking an experienced Production Coordinator to join an established and growing schoolwear business. This is a hands-on role coordinating garment production from pre-production samples through to bulk delivery, working closely with overseas suppliers and internal sales teams.

The role
  • Manage a high volume of production orders and  pre-production samples annually
  • Coordinate production across an approved supplier base in China and Vietnam
  • Review production documentation, approvals, pricing and supplier allocations
  • Monitor production milestones, identify risks and proactively manage delivery timelines
  • Coordinate seasonal, high-volume production cycles
  • Build strong relationships with overseas suppliers and internal sales teams
  • Assist with quality issues, replenishment orders and freight coordination
  • Contribute to improving production processes, systems and workflow consistency
About you
  • Previous experience in garment production
  • Direct experience in schoolwear or uniform manufacturing
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end garment production lifecycle
  • Experience managing pre-production samples and bulk production orders
  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
  • Confident managing multiple orders and competing deadlines
  • Clear, calm and proactive communication style
  • Fluent Chinese or Vietnamese would be highly regarded
Success in this role will look like:
Accurate and efficient order management, early identification of production risks, strong supplier relationships and consistent execution through busy seasonal periods.

If you have schoolwear or uniform production experience and are looking for your next opportunity, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Apparel Designer - Freelance/Consultancy
job.description:
Senior Apparel Designer
 Melbourne | Freelance / Consultancy Opportunity
Location: Melbourne, Australia

Our client is an established global apparel manufacturer with its own manufacturing and product development capabilities and a strong international presence.

About the opportunity
This role suits a commercially minded designer who enjoys translating trends into relevant product, working directly with buyers and building lasting relationships. You will collaborate closely with the UK design team and merchandising, product development and production teams in Bangladesh, taking ideas from concept through to sampling and production.
 
What you’ll be doing
  • Build strong relationships with buyers and design teams at major Australian retail chains.
  • Understand each customer’s brand identity, product requirements, price points and opportunities for growth.
  • Create and present commercially focused design concepts, ranges and trend direction.
  • Work with the UK design team to develop products suited to the Australian market.
  • Collaborate with overseas teams on product development, sampling and delivery.
  • Manage briefs, artwork and product information accurately, keeping deadlines and follow-up on track.
  • Bring fresh ideas and product innovation beyond responding to customer technical packs.
  • Support new customer relationships as the Australian business grows.
About you
 You are an experienced apparel designer with a strong eye for trends and a practical understanding of what makes a range commercially successful. You enjoy hands-on design and feel confident presenting ideas and working through feedback with retail buyers.

You will bring:
  • Strong apparel design experience, ideally at a middle-to-senior level.
  • Experience working within, or supplying to, major Australian retail chains.
  • An understanding of the Australian apparel market and volume retail requirements.
  • Established relationships with retail buyers or design teams are highly regarded.
  • The ability to balance creative ideas with pricing, customer needs and manufacturing capabilities.
  • Experience collaborating with overseas design, merchandising or production teams.
  • Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage your work independently.
  • An interest in building customer relationships and contributing to business growth.
Working arrangements
This opportunity is suitable for a freelancer or consultant operating through their own business and ABN. Hours and rates will be discussed based on your experience and availability.

You will need to be available for customer meetings in Melbourne and have some flexibility to collaborate with international teams.

Interested?
Please apply with your resume and portfolio. 

This opportunity is open exclusively to Melbourne-based applicants.
